description: This source file contains an extension for the 'OnboardingView' class, providing async functions to manage workspace setup, bootstrap, and configuration persistence within the application. It includes methods for loading, ensuring, applying, and saving workspace configurations, along with helper properties and functions related to workspace commands.

methods.name: loadWorkspaceDefaults
methods.description: Async function to load and initialize workspace path if not already set.

methods.name: ensureDefaultWorkspace
methods.description: Async function that ensures the workspace is set up correctly, creating it if needed, handling safety checks.

methods.name: refreshBootstrapStatus
methods.description: Updates the bootstrap requirement status based on current workspace URL.

methods.name: workspaceBootstrapCommand
methods.description: Computes a shell command string to create a workspace directory and insert a template into a Markdown file.

methods.name: applyWorkspace
methods.description: Async function to apply or create the workspace, updating the status accordingly.

methods.name: loadAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Private async helper to load the current workspace configuration.

methods.name: saveAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Async function to save the workspace string into the configuration.

methods.name: buildAndSaveWorkspace
methods.description: Static async helper that loads, updates, and saves the workspace configuration.
